label: Test selective operative-input deletion as a local productive-path diagnostic
summary: Draft handoff for #1934, docs/notes/actuality-esse-research.md, Source-specific productive deletion. A proposed Supply-induction lemma says loss of an originally supplied target after deleting groups using selected productive inputs implies a nonempty contributor path from a selected input to that same target. Reproduced finite structural diagnostic: 8192 assignments, 8146 supplied targets, 194 losses after the productive cut and no loss without such a path, 6846 selected-input paths despite surviving the cut, 98 recipient-esse-cut losses without the selected-input path. Both bearer-esse supplies are preserved by the productive cut. A separate two-context control preserves a retained determination without a present selected-input path; it changes the seed basis and does not instantiate the fixed-seed lemma. No proof or causal attribution is mechanically verified; these counts supersede unrecorded chat counts for the stated fixture only. No new source claim or change to earlier judgments.
